stubs.service: Cloudflare Workers platform (D1 database, R2 image/file buckets, KV, rate limiters)
stubs.how: wrangler dev runs the production build in local workerd/miniflare with file-backed state persisted in .ui-capture/state (seeded by .ui-capture/seed.sh)

.ui-capture/stripe-stub.mjs, a local Node server started by start.sh on port 4479 (STRIPE_STUB_PORT). The Worker's Stripe SDK is pointed at it via a STRIPE_API_BASE var (small host override added in src/features/payments/stripe.ts). It implements checkout.sessions create/retrieve/list and refunds create/list, serves a hosted-checkout page at http://localhost:4479/c/pay/<id>, and on Pay sends a correctly signed checkout.session.completed webhook to /api/webhook/stripe before redirecting to the order confirmation. Stub keys (sk_test_…, whsec_local_stub_fernwood) were saved through Admin → Settings → Payments into the encrypted vault.

stubs.service: Cloudflare Workers cache purge (cache.purge from cloudflare:workers)
stubs.how: Local workerd exposes no purge(); src/features/cache/purge.ts treats purging as a no-op when the runtime lacks purge() (nothing to invalidate locally). Production behaviour unchanged.

stubs.service: Lightning (phoenixd/LNbits), OpenNode, and the Demo rail
stubs.how: Not configured; Lightning and Demo rails were switched off in Admin → Settings so the storefront offers card only. Historical Lightning/OpenNode orders exist as seeded data.
No provider key configured, so the app's email seam is its built-in safe no-op
Blocked offline; wrangler falls back to its built-in placeholder object

notes: Astro 7 SSR app (minshop) built with `astro build` and served by `wrangler dev` (production mode, admin auth gate active) via .ui-capture/start.sh on $PORT, plus the local Stripe stub on 4479. Node 22.23.5 pinned in mise.toml; deps via `npm ci`. Two source changes, both only for running offline: a no-op cache purge when the runtime lacks purge(), and an optional Stripe API host override. Data: .ui-capture/seed.sh wipes .ui-capture/state, applies the repo's migrations, runs the app's own first-run setup wizard over HTTP (store 'Fernwood Supply Co.', a Portland home-goods & coffee shop, time zone America/Los_Angeles, admin password), saves the Stripe keys and turns off Demo/Lightning via the Admin Settings form, uploads 46 product photos (rendered by gen-images.mjs) through the admin media API, then loads seed-data.sql generated by gen-seed.mjs: 10 categories (nested Coffee & Tea → Coffee/Tea, Home → Candles), 46 products with variants (grind, glaze, size, color), add-ons (gift wrap, engraving), sold-out/low-stock items and 2 archived; ~244 paid orders Jan 14 – Nov 16 2026 from ~95 customers (mostly card, some Lightning/OpenNode, two owner demo tests), shipped with USPS/UPS/FedEx tracking, local pickups, recent ones still unfulfilled, discounts, full and partial refunds with reasons; 7 Markdown pages (About, Shipping, Returns, Privacy, FAQ published; Wholesale and Holiday Gift Guide drafts); header/footer menus; US/Canada shipping zones with weight bands and free-over-$75; announcement bar. Entry is the admin dashboard; /admin/login asks only for the password. Main areas: admin (/admin dashboard, products, orders + order detail, customers, categories, pages, navigation, shipping, media, settings) and storefront (/ catalog, /categories/<slug>, /products/<slug>, /search, /cart, /pages/<slug>, card checkout via the stub).
